title: Update readme and example to cover root privs
Revisit Advanced tier styling for dark mode
description:
The badge color is pretty close to the background color of the site.
Accessibility passes but it could be improved.

title: Add official Preview badge
description: Currently, workbench is styling the "alt" badge to use as a feature preview badge. We should add an official preview badge instead.

title: Add icon tier for requires root
description: We should have a "requires root" icon that we can insert using the `tier` functionality. I don't want to overuse the text badges so an icon seems like a good use to indicate a command would requires root while also being able to easily add it to the docs.

title: Add border or something for dark mode
description: When the badges are used with the Posit theme, they don't "pop" enough. Short-term fix is to add a white border

title: Add a Beta tag/badge
description: We have the alternate badge that can be modified to flag beta features which is great but would be nice if there was a set beta badge :)

title: `target=url` for tag badges
description:
To increase the chances of our users finding the information and context that may help explain these new badges and avoid support inquiries, we would like to be able to add a URL to them so a user can click the badge and be redirected to the documentation that explains this new tier system.

My initial thought was to have all of them linked to docs.posit.co/licensing (page doesn't exist yet) but I wanted to confirm. 

Is there a way to add the option so folks can populate the URL once they add it to the repo?
